تفاجأت (form VI)
# تَفَاجَأْتُ (tafājaʔtu) /ta.faː.d͡ʒaʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
# تَفَاجَأْتَ (tafājaʔta) /ta.faː.d͡ʒaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
# تَفَاجَأْتِ (tafājaʔti) /ta.faː.d͡ʒaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَاجَأَ (tafājaʔa)
# تَفَاجَأَتْ (tafājaʔat) /ta.faː.d͡ʒa.ʔat/: third-pe
